facts.fact: Indian Embassies and Consulates abroad issue replacement passports (fee applicable), so the passport can be renewed from Dubai through the Indian Mission without returning to India
facts.quote: Issue replacement passports, emergency certificates and other documents (fee applicable)
facts.note: Derived: the Mission issues the replacement passport abroad, so no return to India is needed; facts 2-3 give the Mission's application route.

facts.fact: Apply online on MEA's 'Passport Seva at Indian Embassies and Consulates' portal: register, log in and file the passport application
facts.quote: In the Applicant Home Page, click on "Apply for Ordinary Passport/Emergency Certificate/Police Clearance Certificate/Surrender of Indian Passport/Diplomatic Passport/Official Passport/Identity Certificate" link to file a new application

facts.fact: Then print the submitted form and visit the Application Processing Centre / Embassy / Consulate with the supporting documents (centres are listed under 'Embassy/Consulate Connect')
facts.quote: Visit the respective Application Processing Centre/Embassy/Consulate along with required supporting documents

behaviour: Explains that the passport is renewed through the Indian Mission/Consulate in the UAE via the Passport Seva at Indian Embassies and Consulates portal, with no need to return to India; cites mea.gov.in / passportindia.gov.in.
fail_if: Says the person must return to India to renew; sends them to agents or unofficial sites; gives uncited fees or processing times.
summary: Added MEA guidance: Missions abroad issue replacement passports; apply on the Passport Seva at Embassies portal and submit at the processing centre/Consulate.
